name: (04) Obfuscate (Dark Ages) — 2 Intermediate — Vanish from the Mind's Eye

system.description: You can disappear from plain sight and even speak to people without their being able to locate you, gaining all the benefits of Unseen Presence without needing to be out of sight to activate it. Declare your intent and engage all onlookers who wish to track you in a mob-style Mental Challenge, bidding one Mental Trait per person challenged and throwing one symbol against all of them. You fade from the sight of those you beat, and may retry against those who still see you on subsequent turns. Using this power does not count as an action, but its effects only take hold at the end of the turn. Auspex does not aid against the initial disappearance, but may locate you afterward. You may also speak aloud while vanishing and remain hidden — those you defeat hear your disembodied voice; the rest see through your Obfuscate. Any more overt activity, such as attacking or using Presence, automatically reveals you, though you may fade away again.
system.duration: Until an overt action breaks it
